description: This file defines a React component for the Events page of a web application, including listing events, handling loading and error states, creating/deleting events, and rendering event cards with various UI interactions.

methods.name: EventsPage
methods.description: Main React component rendering the list of events and handling user interactions such as creating and deleting events.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of an event after user confirmation, updates local state accordingly.

methods.name: EventCard
methods.description: Subcomponent rendering details and actions for a single event, including status, timestamps, venue, capacity, and action buttons.
